Class PyronautNativeImageBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.pyronaut.nativebuild.PyronautNativeImageBuilder
public final class PyronautNativeImageBuilder extends Object
Builds a Crema native image capable of loading an already compiled Pyronaut application at runtime.

The builder deliberately receives its runtime classpath explicitly. This prevents build-time tooling from accidentally becoming part of a production launcher image.
